summary: Palomar Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its board approved a $200 million share repurchase plan effective May 6, 2026, with a two-year term, replacing a prior plan. No price per share, premium, or specific dates were disclosed; the plan authorizes open-market purchases as conditions warrant. The company also reported Q1 2026 results, including net income of $42.9M. As issuer, Palomar is returning capital to shareholders via buybacks. Watch for execution pace and potential impact on EPS; no risk-arb angle as this is an ordinary-course authorization.
